WITH enc AS (
  SELECT e.pat_ref, e.enc_key, e.time_mark, e.miss_appt, asd.rec_status,
    (CASE asd.funcassess->>'Soc_Sup' WHEN 'Strong' THEN 3 WHEN 'Adequate' THEN 2 WHEN 'Limited' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
   + CASE asd.funcassess->>'Rel_Qual' WHEN 'Good' THEN 3 WHEN 'Fair' THEN 2 WHEN 'Poor' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS sse
  FROM encounters e JOIN assessmentsocialanddiagnosis asd ON asd.asd_key = e.ab_ref
), stable AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT e.pat_ref
  FROM enc e JOIN treatmentbasics tb ON tb.enc_ref = e.enc_key
  JOIN treatmentoutcomes t ON t.tx_ref = tb.tx_key
  WHERE e.rec_status = 'Stable' AND lower(t.txprogmet->>'Func_Impv') IN ('moderate','significant')
), pat AS (
  SELECT pat_ref, AVG(miss_appt) AS avg_missed_appointments FROM encounters GROUP BY pat_ref
), latest AS (
  SELECT pat_ref, sse, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pat_ref ORDER BY time_mark DESC, enc_key DESC) AS rn FROM enc
)
SELECT DISTINCT s.pat_ref AS patient_id, p.avg_missed_appointments, l.sse AS most_recent_sse
FROM stable s JOIN pat p ON p.pat_ref = s.pat_ref JOIN latest l ON l.pat_ref = s.pat_ref AND l.rn = 1
WHERE p.avg_missed_appointments > 2 OR l.sse < 3
note: Social support value 'Moderate' in data is not in the SSE mapping; unmapped values scored 0.

WITH enc AS (
  SELECT e.clin_id, e.fac_id, e.pat_ref, e.enc_key, e.miss_appt
  FROM encounters e
  JOIN facilities f ON f.fac_key = e.fac_id
  WHERE f.com_res IN ('Adequate','Comprehensive','Extensive')
), crisis AS (
  SELECT enc.clin_id, enc.fac_id, SUM(tb.crisis_int) AS total_crisis
  FROM enc JOIN treatmentbasics tb ON tb.enc_ref = enc.enc_key
  GROUP BY enc.clin_id, enc.fac_id
), agg AS (
  SELECT clin_id, fac_id, COUNT(DISTINCT pat_ref) AS n_pat, SUM(miss_appt) AS total_missed
  FROM enc GROUP BY clin_id, fac_id
), psm AS (
  SELECT a.clin_id, a.fac_id,
    1.0 / (1 + COALESCE(c.total_crisis,0)::numeric / NULLIF(a.n_pat,0) + COALESCE(a.total_missed,0)::numeric / NULLIF(a.n_pat,0)) AS psm
  FROM agg a LEFT JOIN crisis c ON c.clin_id = a.clin_id AND c.fac_id = a.fac_id
)
SELECT clin_id AS clinician_id, fac_id AS facility_id, ROUND(psm, 2) AS psm,
  RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY fac_id ORDER BY psm DESC) AS psm_rank
FROM psm
ORDER BY fac_id, psm_rank, clin_id
LIMIT 100

WITH hr AS (
  SELECT e.pat_ref, e.ab_ref, e.enc_key, e.time_mark, e.fac_id,
    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY e.pat_ref ORDER BY e.time_mark DESC, e.enc_key DESC) AS rn
  FROM encounters e
  JOIN assessmentsymptomsandrisk asr ON asr.asr_key = e.ab_ref
  JOIN facilities f ON f.fac_key = e.fac_id
  WHERE (asr.suic_risk = 'High' OR asr.phq9_scr > 15 OR asr.gad7_scr > 15)
    AND (f.env_stress = 'Severe' OR f.life_impact = 'Severe')
), tes AS (
  SELECT e.pat_ref,
    AVG(CASE tb.th_eng WHEN 'High' THEN 3 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 END) AS avg_tes
  FROM encounters e JOIN treatmentbasics tb ON tb.enc_ref = e.enc_key
  GROUP BY e.pat_ref
)
SELECT hr.pat_ref AS patient_id, hr.ab_ref AS assessment_id, hr.time_mark AS assessment_date,
  ROUND(t.avg_tes) AS avg_tes_rounded,
  CASE WHEN f.env_stress = 'Severe' THEN f.env_stress ELSE f.life_impact END AS stress_or_impact_level
FROM hr
JOIN tes t ON t.pat_ref = hr.pat_ref
JOIN facilities f ON f.fac_key = hr.fac_id
WHERE hr.rn = 1 AND t.avg_tes < 2
ORDER BY hr.time_mark DESC
LIMIT 50

WITH dx AS (
  SELECT e.enc_key, e.pat_ref, asd.prim_dx
  FROM encounters e
  JOIN assessmentsocialanddiagnosis asd ON asd.asd_key = e.ab_ref
  WHERE asd.prim_dx IS NOT NULL
), crisis AS (
  SELECT dx.prim_dx, SUM(tb.crisis_int) AS total_crisis
  FROM dx JOIN treatmentbasics tb ON tb.enc_ref = dx.enc_key
  GROUP BY dx.prim_dx
), pats AS (
  SELECT prim_dx, COUNT(DISTINCT pat_ref) AS patient_count FROM dx GROUP BY prim_dx
)
SELECT p.prim_dx AS diagnosis, p.patient_count,
  ROUND(COALESCE(c.total_crisis, 0)::numeric / NULLIF(p.patient_count, 0), 2) AS cif
FROM pats p LEFT JOIN crisis c ON c.prim_dx = p.prim_dx
ORDER BY cif DESC
LIMIT 100

WITH p AS (
  SELECT split_part(therapy_exp_intensity, ' ', 1)::numeric AS intensity,
         split_part(treatment_cost_eff, ' ', 1)::numeric AS cost_eff
  FROM assessmentbasics
  WHERE pat_owner_ref = 'P425079'
)
SELECT ROUND(6000.0 / (100 * 1.25), 2) AS affordable_therapy_hours,
       (intensity >= 30) AS meets_intensity_target,
       ROUND(cost_eff * 6000, 2) AS projected_qol_gain,
       (cost_eff * 6000 > 650) AS exceeds_clinical_threshold
FROM p
note: Uses the patient's stored intensity and cost-effectiveness values (0.11976...) rather than the rounded 0.1197 in the question; gain 718.56 vs 718.20.

WITH fac_tar AS (
  SELECT e.fac_id,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.txprogmet->>'Tx_Adh' IN ('High', 'Medium', 'Compliant'))::numeric / COUNT(*) AS tar
  FROM encounters e
  JOIN treatmentbasics t ON t.enc_ref = e.enc_key
  JOIN treatmentoutcomes o ON o.tx_ref = t.tx_key
  GROUP BY e.fac_id
), fac_res AS (
  SELECT f.fac_key,
         CASE WHEN f.com_res IN ('Comprehensive', 'Extensive') THEN 3
              WHEN f.com_res = 'Adequate' THEN 2
              WHEN f.com_res = 'Limited' THEN 1 END AS res_score
  FROM facilities f
)
SELECT ROUND(CORR(r.res_score, t.tar)::numeric, 4) AS craa
FROM fac_tar t
JOIN fac_res r ON r.fac_key = t.fac_id
WHERE r.res_score IS NOT NULL

WITH pfis AS (
  SELECT e.fac_id,
         AVG(CASE LOWER(s.func_imp) WHEN 'severe' THEN 3 WHEN 'moderate' THEN 2 WHEN 'mild' THEN 1 END) AS pfis
  FROM encounters e
  JOIN assessmentsocialanddiagnosis s ON s.asd_key = e.ab_ref
  GROUP BY e.fac_id
), frai AS (
  SELECT f.fac_key AS fac_id,
         CASE WHEN f.com_res IN ('Comprehensive', 'Extensive') THEN 3
              WHEN f.com_res = 'Adequate' THEN 2
              WHEN f.com_res = 'Limited' THEN 1 END AS frai
  FROM facilities f
), tes AS (
  SELECT e.fac_id,
         AVG(CASE t.th_eng WHEN 'High' THEN 3 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tes
  FROM encounters e
  JOIN treatmentbasics t ON t.enc_ref = e.enc_key
  GROUP BY e.fac_id
), tar AS (
  SELECT e.fac_id,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.txprogmet->>'Tx_Adh' IN ('High', 'Medium', 'Compliant'))::numeric / COUNT(*) AS tar
  FROM encounters e
  JOIN treatmentbasics t ON t.enc_ref = e.enc_key
  JOIN treatmentoutcomes o ON o.tx_ref = t.tx_key
  GROUP BY e.fac_id
), mar AS (
  SELECT e.fac_id, SUM(e.miss_appt)::numeric / NULLIF(COUNT(DISTINCT e.pat_ref), 0) AS mar
  FROM encounters e
  GROUP BY e.fac_id
)
SELECT p.fac_id AS facility_id, ROUND((p.pfis - r.frai)::numeric, 2) AS rdd
FROM pfis p
JOIN frai r ON r.fac_id = p.fac_id
JOIN tes ON tes.fac_id = p.fac_id
JOIN tar ON tar.fac_id = p.fac_id
JOIN mar ON mar.fac_id = p.fac_id
WHERE (p.pfis - r.frai) > 1.0
  AND (tes.tes + tar.tar * 3) / 2 < 1.5
  AND mar.mar > 2.5
ORDER BY rdd DESC, p.fac_id
LIMIT 100

SELECT a.pat_owner_ref AS patient_id,
       s.dx_dur_m AS diagnosis_duration_months,
       s.prev_hosp AS previous_hospitalizations,
       (SPLIT_PART(a.therapy_exp_intensity, ' ', 1)::numeric >= 15) AS meets_intensive_therapy_standard
FROM assessmentsocialanddiagnosis s
JOIN assessmentbasics a ON a.ab_key = s.asd_key
WHERE s.prim_dx = 'Bipolar'
  AND s.dx_dur_m >= 120
  AND s.prev_hosp > 3

WITH sym AS (
  SELECT p.pat_eth, r.phq9_scr, r.gad7_scr
  FROM patients p
  JOIN encounters e ON e.pat_ref = p.pat_key
  JOIN assessmentsymptomsandrisk r ON r.asr_key = e.ab_ref
), trt AS (
  SELECT p.pat_eth,
         CASE t.th_eng WHEN 'High' THEN 3 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS eng_score,
         CASE WHEN o.txprogmet->>'Tx_Adh' IN ('High', 'Medium', 'Compliant') THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END AS adh_flag,
         o.tx_out_key
  FROM patients p
  JOIN encounters e ON e.pat_ref = p.pat_key
  JOIN treatmentbasics t ON t.enc_ref = e.enc_key
  LEFT JOIN treatmentoutcomes o ON o.tx_ref = t.tx_key
), ssi AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(pat_eth, 'All Ethnicities') AS ethnicity,
         (AVG(phq9_scr) + AVG(gad7_scr)) / 2 AS ssi
  FROM sym
  GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((pat_eth), ())
), eas AS (
  SELECT COALESCE(pat_eth, 'All Ethnicities') AS ethnicity,
         (AVG(eng_score) + (SUM(adh_flag) FILTER (WHERE tx_out_key IS NOT NULL) / NULLIF(COUNT(tx_out_key), 0)) * 3) / 2 AS eas
  FROM trt
  GROUP BY GROUPING SETS ((pat_eth), ())
)
SELECT s.ethnicity, ROUND(s.ssi, 2) AS symptom_severity_index, ROUND(e.eas, 2) AS engagement_adherence_score
FROM ssi s
LEFT JOIN eas e ON e.ethnicity = s.ethnicity
ORDER BY s.ethnicity

WITH tes AS (
  SELECT e.fac_id,
         AVG(CASE t.th_eng WHEN 'High' THEN 3 WHEN 'Medium' THEN 2 WHEN 'Low' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS tes
  FROM encounters e
  JOIN treatmentbasics t ON t.enc_ref = e.enc_key
  GROUP BY e.fac_id
), outc AS (
  SELECT e.fac_id,
         AVG(CASE LOWER(o.txprogmet->>'Func_Impv') WHEN 'significant' THEN 3 WHEN 'moderate' THEN 2 WHEN 'minimal' THEN 1 END) AS avg_fis,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.txprogmet->>'Tx_Adh' IN ('High', 'Medium', 'Compliant'))::numeric / COUNT(*) AS tar
  FROM encounters e
  JOIN treatmentbasics t ON t.enc_ref = e.enc_key
  JOIN treatmentoutcomes o ON o.tx_ref = t.tx_key
  GROUP BY e.fac_id
)
SELECT tes.fac_id AS facility_id,
       ROUND(tes.tes, 2) AS avg_tes,
       ROUND(outc.avg_fis * outc.tar, 2) AS rti
FROM tes
JOIN outc ON outc.fac_id = tes.fac_id
WHERE tes.tes > 2.0
  AND outc.avg_fis * outc.tar < 0.8
ORDER BY tes.fac_id
LIMIT 100
